answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each applicant vertex must file a kernel work record: one task, held for 20 epochs. Each epoch, random auditors re-run a 5% sample; a vertex that cannot reproduce its kernel work loses its bond, and its sponsor shares the penalty. Past the audit ridge, faking 100 identities needs 100 records at 40 credits each, 4,000 credits for one honest share. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
